subject: Budget range validation — ZenPay monthly spend & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@zenpay.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + quick budget questions (ZenPay)

Hi Anna — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can build a tailored quote: 

Recap:
- Primary use: transaction classification + customer support summarization (low-latency previews + batch embeddings)
- Expected concurrency: low (few hundred qps peak), but sustained monthly volume is the main driver
- Security: will need VPC/private deployment for production

Asks to validate pricing and procurement path: 
1) Ballpark monthly token volume (for current pilot -> next 12 months): range is fine (e.g., 5M–30M tokens/mo)
2) Target unit economics you're aiming for (approx $/1M tokens target) or target monthly spend band (e.g., $5k–$50k/mo)
3) Any procurement thresholds we should be aware of (PO levels, approvals, contract review timelines)

Attaching a quick estimate for two consumption profiles to help guide. If you can reply with 1–3 above, we'll run a precise estimate and provide the procurement docs you need.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if that's easier.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0124
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Lee <anna.lee@zenpay.com>

Cc: ZenPay Procurement <procurement@zenpay.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick budget questions (ZenPay)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and the estimate. Quick answers below: 

1) Ballpark monthly tokens: for pilot -> scale we expect roughly 10M–30M tokens/month (pilot ~10M, production ~20–30M over 6–12 months).
2) Target unit economics: our internal target is around $900 – $1,200 per 1M tokens (we're trying to keep costs under $25k/mo initially). If you can get below ~$1,000/1M at scale that would be ideal.
3) Procurement thresholds: anything under $25k can be handled with our Ops PO and standard SOW. >$25k requires legal review + platform security sign-off and typically 3–4 weeks. >$75k needs exec approval and SOW + vendor risk assessment.

I'm attaching our procurement form to speed things up. We can schedule a short call with procurement if you want — CC'd them.

Anna Lee
Head of Product, ZenPay
anna.lee@zenpay.com | +1 (212) 555-0189
ZenPay

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lee <anna.lee@zenpay.com>
Cc: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, procurement@zenpay.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + quick budget questions (ZenPay)

Thanks Anna — this is super helpful. Quick notes / next steps: 

- Pricing approach: based on 10–30M tokens/mo and your $900–$1,200/1M target, we'll prepare two options:
  1) Hosted consumption tier (no infra commitment) — good for pilot, list price ~ $1,200/1M with volume discounts at 20M+.
  2) Dedicated reserved capacity (recommended at steady 20M+ tokens/mo) — delivers ~$800–$950/1M effective at committed monthly levels. This is typically the best unit economics once you cross ~15–20M tokens/mo.

- Procurement fit: note your $25k threshold — a committed Dedicated contract can be structured monthly or annual with PO. We'll prepare a quote that keeps initial monthly spend under $25k (pilot) and a ramp path showing the break-even point for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Action items:
- I'll send a formal quote + commitment options by EOD tomorrow (including a breakout for token costs, reserved capacity fee if any, and estimated monthly spend for 10/20/30M tokens).
- If procurement prefers, we can issue a pilot PO < $25k and follow with an annual committed agreement once you're ready.
- Can procurement provide the standard PO terms (or confirm if they need Redwood's standard MSA)?

Attaching the estimate I referenced and a short note on our Dedicated economics.

Best,
Marissa
Attachment: Redwood-pricing-estimate-zenpay.pdf (attached)

Subject: Re: Budget range validation — ZenPay monthly spend & procurement thresholds

Hi Anna / Marissa — looping in some unit-econ details from SE side. 

Quick unit-econ examples (ballpark):
- Hosted consumption (no commitment): $1,200 / 1M tokens -> 10M tokens = $12k/mo, 20M = $24k/mo, 30M = $36k/mo.
- Dedicated reserved (example committed): effective $850 / 1M tokens at 20M commit -> 20M = ~$17k/mo (plus any fixed reserved infra fee if annualized).

So: if ZenPay wants to keep initial spend under the $25k procurement threshold, a hosted pilot at ~20M would sit right at that boundary (~$24k). If you expect to run steady 20M+, Dedicated commitment will both lower unit cost (~$850/1M) and simplify procurement (single committed invoice).

Next steps I recommend: 
- Marissa: include a 10M pilot quote and a 20M committed quote in the official proposal.
- Anna / Procurement: if you can share the PO template or confirm whether a pilot PO < $25k is acceptable, we'll send the pilot invoice and MSA for signatures.

Happy to join a procurement call — I can walk through the monthly math and reserved vs hosted tradeoffs.

—
